text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations!
Your team members are finally all gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado, I have prepared
a clubroom for everyone on the team.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...However, right now it's still bare minimum.
We don't have enough training equipment yet."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Still, if we win the Aoharu Cup
and raise our team's rank,
we'll be able to get a lot more budget accordingly!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that, we'll be able to conduct more fulfilling,
high-level team training, don't you think?♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To help your team run at its best,
be sure to aim for great success in the Aoharu Cup!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Let us proceed immediately with the necessary
procedures to enter the Aoharu Cup.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll hand you the race entry form,
so please fill out the required information and submit it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Well then, I wish you the best of luck.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is a field for the team name on the race entry form.
How about something like Team <Carrots>?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I feel like we got
a few suggestions from the team members too...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The team name will be—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided on the name <HOP CHEERS>
and filled out the registration form!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From now on, I want us to work hard together
as a united team!
